title: Weak regularity of arbitrary triangular monic equations
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $d,r\geq0$, let $0\ne h\in k[X_0,\ldots,X_{d-1}]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], and let $p_i\in k[X_0,\ldots,X_{d+i}][Z]$ have leading coefficient one for every $0\leq i<r$. Then the list $f$ of [def-weil-pbc-triangular-field-model-equations] is weakly regular on the polynomial ring $k[X_0,\ldots,X_{d+r}]$: multiplication by its entry $j$ is injective on the quotient by its preceding entries, for every $0\leq j<r+1$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. No condition on the final quotient is asserted.

proof.text: The ambient polynomial ring is a domain. Regarding hT - 1 as a polynomial in T, its constant coefficient -1 proves it nonzero; therefore multiplication by it is injective.

proof.text: Use the localization presentation to quotient by hT - 1. After additionally quotienting by the first i triangular equations, the ring is B_i[Y_i,...,Y_{r-1}], where B_i is the quotient of k[X,1/h,Y_0,...,Y_{i-1}] by the earlier monic equations. The equality follows by successive quotients and by the absence of later variables from earlier equations.

proof.text: The next polynomial is the image of p_i. It is monic in Y_i over B_i[Y_{i+1},...,Y_{r-1}], since coefficient ring maps preserve monicity. A monic polynomial is a nonzerodivisor even if its coefficient ring has zero divisors or is zero. Transport multiplication injectivity through the quotient isomorphism.

proof.text: These injectivity assertions are exactly regular_mod_prev for the displayed list. If r=0 only the first equation occurs. If some p_i is the constant one, later quotients can be zero; weak regularity still holds, so no improper conclusion of regularity is asserted.

lean.statement:
theorem triangularFieldModelEquations_isWeaklyRegular
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (d r : ℕ) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k)
    (p : (i : Fin r) → Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + i.val)) k))
    (hh : h ≠ 0) (hp : ∀ i, (p i).Monic) :
    RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + r)) k)
      (triangularFieldModelEquations k d r h p)
